messages:
sara (newhire): hi team :wave: I'm trying to reach the internal dev-db from my laptop. Followed the onboarding doc but `psql` times out. Using M1 macbook with WireGuard + split-tunnel. Any tips?

kevin: welcome! can you paste `ip route` and `wg show` outputs? also confirm you're trying to hit `internal-dev` or the IP. are you on the corp wifi or home network?

sara (newhire): corp wifi. here is `ip route`:
```
default via 192.168.1.1 dev en0
10.42.0.0/16 via 10.10.10.1 dev utun2
169.254.0.0/16 dev en0 scope link
```
and `wg show` shows the peer connected with latest handshake.

maya: quick check — do you have the internal DNS suffix set? split-tunnel config only forwards internal domains. if your client doesn't get our internal DNS the hostname won't resolve to VPC IPs.

oncall-sre: saw a similar case yesterday. try an SSH jump through bastion: `ssh -J ec2-user@bastion-us-east-1 ec2-user@internal-dev` then run `psql` from the bastion. that helps narrow client vs network.

alex: you can also test raw TCP: `nc -vz internal-dev 5432` or `curl -v http://internal-dev:5432` to see whether TCP handshake happens.

ops-bot: Ticket #INFR-4823 created for sara (newhire): "newhire network access - bastion/routing". Assigned to eng-infra.

sara (newhire): ran `ssh -J` and `psql` from bastion still times out. `nc -vz internal-dev 5432` from bastion returns "connect: connection refused".

kevin: ok that suggests the DB is not listening on that interface or SG/network ACL blocking. Which DB cluster? dev-db-eu or dev-db-us?

sara (newhire): dev-db-us.

kevin: looking at infra — the DB is in a private subnet reachable only from certain bastion ENIs. Your session was routed through a newer bastion in a different subnet; security group lacks that bastion's IP. I’ll add a temporary SG rule and re-run checks.

kevin: updated SG to allow port 5432 from bastion-us-east-1-eni (temporary 1hr). try `psql` again.

sara (newhire): omg it's working now :tada: thanks!

maya: for permanent fix we'll add the bastion subnets to the DB SG and update the onboarding doc. sara, could you open a tiny PR to /docs/onboarding/network.md noting the WireGuard split-tunnel gotcha? we'll merge.

sara (newhire): can do, thanks everyone! saved me a lot of time. :relieved:

kevin: filed a follow-up CHORE #ENGINF-901 to permanently add the missing bastion ENIs to the SG and add an automated test for new bastion provisioning.

ops-bot: CHORE #ENGINF-901 created: "bastion-to-db SG coverage + onboarding doc update". Assigned to eng-infra.

maya: glad that worked. tagging this thread for the onboarding checklist so next new hire doesn't hit it. :white_check_mark:
